_comment: RED ON PURPOSE from birth: expected.sourceIndexes is a PLACEHOLDER, not a verified target.
The regress harness ignores this key (fixtureSchema strips what it does not name).
PROVENANCE. Demo ee69edfa-7ef1-43f0-a653-79b533a506a7, analysis 208695ff, 80 states,
recorded 2026-08-17, exported 2026-08-21. It is the only production timeline that produced
a violation with no fixture behind it. NOT a duplicate of real-botteacher-study-app: that
fixture is demo ba70c3d7 and, although also 80 states of the same product, differs in 558
fields (different thumbPath demo id, different action and screenName wording) — compared
field by field, not by hash. Hashing these timelines is useless: jsonb reorders keys, so a
live analysis and the fixture cut from it hash differently while being identical content.
WHY IT EXISTS. Its one and only live attempt — plan 9a5ead39, 2026-08-20 21:19:57Z, under
the then-live prompt — threw after the corrective retry with:
step 2: label 'שפוך פה הכל boteacher יעשה לך סדר' is over 6 words
That is the six-word-label class, the one violation class no fixture covered.
The plan row records prompt_version=NULL: failed plans never store it, because only the
success path writes promptVersion. The version is inferred from the run window, not read.
expected.sourceIndexes — PLACEHOLDER. No live run has ever succeeded on this timeline, so
no selection has ever been approved by anyone. It is set to the mechanical selection purely
to keep the shape valid, and it WILL be red under a real key. Re-pin it to the first live
plan that both clears the validator and survives founder review. Until then a FAIL row here
says nothing about the prompt under test — read the error text, never the pass/fail bit.
expected.dryRunSourceIndexes — LOAD-BEARING, do not edit. [42,47,48,60,74,79] is what the
canned keyless planner returns for this timeline, and the packages/core 'plan regress' test
asserts it under DRY_RUN. Changing it turns the core suite red.
COST OF KEEPING THIS FILE. 'aiugc plan regress' runs every fixture in this directory, so
this one adds about 2 paid Claude calls per live run — roughly 40k tokens, about 0.50 ILS —
for a row that is guaranteed red until the pin is replaced. Delete it if that stops paying.
2026-09-23 (the pinned access step, feat/plan-access-step): both pins gain the access step, 2.
THE PIN (findAccessMoment): window = states before the first product/loading state = 0..7
(8 is "loading"). Candidates = type/select states, not unreadable/dup, kind not
login/onboarding/error/tour, a visibleText entry with a domain token and no "@": states 2,
3, 4, 5, 6 (all `type`, `other`, legibility low, "boteacher.com"); 7 is a `tap`, 0-1 carry
no domain. Run [2,3,4,5,6] (gaps 2000/400/600/1000ms, all within one 3000ms step). runEnd =
the state after the run = state 7 at 5600ms. Pin = the LATEST run candidate whose 3000ms
expected.dryRunSourceIndexes [42,47,48,60,74,79] -> [2,42,47,48,60,74,79], DERIVED: the
canned planner now gets min 4 / max 6 and may not select 2-6, but the address-bar states
are legibility low and were never in its quality pool, so that pool is the same five
[42,47,48,60,74] (<= 6, so subsampleClusters is the identity) plus the ending 79, and the
spacing walk changes nothing. Only the pin is new. Still LOAD-BEARING under DRY_RUN.
expected.sourceIndexes (live) [42,47,48,60,74,79] -> [2,42,47,48,60,74,79]: still the
PLACEHOLDER it always was, now carrying the pin every live plan on this timeline contains.
